description: Tension — Other-ripples detected; gradient between safe travel and Reveal

drone.prompt: Isolated DRONE BASS STEM for layered production: slow rising low frequency drone with subtle phase-shift modulation, sense of approach, in C minor at 64 bpm, creeping dimensional dread, scanner-detecting-something-wrong, uncertain tension that doesn't resolve, stems-only mix

pulse.prompt: Isolated RHYTHMIC PULSE STEM for layered production: irregular high-frequency scanner-tick patterns, anxious detection rhythm, in C minor at 64 bpm, creeping dimensional dread, scanner-detecting-something-wrong, uncertain tension that doesn't resolve, stems-only mix

texture.prompt: Isolated AMBIENT TEXTURE STEM for layered production: faint distant whispers half-heard, displaced air, the edge of a presence you can't quite locate, in C minor at 64 bpm, creeping dimensional dread, scanner-detecting-something-wrong, uncertain tension that doesn't resolve, stems-only mix

notes: Plays when the scanner detects dimensional ripples but the player hasn't seen Them yet. The tonal gradient between safe and the Others' reveal — building dread without resolution.
